name: catalog
title: Catalog
summary: Products and services: categories, prices, photos, stock for products, duration for services. Feeds the website's product/service pages, Scheduling, and Commerce.

name: scheduling
title: Scheduling
summary: Appointments for services: staff/teams with their own calendars, opening hours and days off, booking requests confirmed by staff, no double booking (enforced by the database), confirm/cancel links, calendar files.

name: commerce
title: Commerce
summary: Cart, guest checkout, orders, receipts; payments through swappable providers: pay later (cash, transfer) and Stripe hosted checkout.
